lore.short: With her serpent tail, this proud descendant of the Great Serpent swims gracefully through the Vonetis Sea, aspiring to one day carry the full power of her heritage.

skills.name: Surge of Life
skills.description:
After casting a skill, Kalea creates a Water Zone on the ground. When Kalea casts a skill within this zone, she absorbs it to enhance her next 3 Basic Attacks with different effects:
First Basic Attack: Kalea dashes to the target, dealing  (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.
Second Basic Attack: Kalea unleashes a flurry of attacks, dealing 140 (+8*Hero Level) (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and recovering  (+12% Max HP)  (+80% Total Magic Power) HP to herself and the nearby ally with the lowest HP.
Third Basic Attack: Kalea strikes around the target with her tail, dealing 70 (+4*Hero Level) (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and creating a new Water Zone.
Enhanced Basic Attacks are not affected by Attack Speed.
Control effects can affect Kalea during the third Enhanced Basic Attack, but cannot interrupt it.

skills.name: Wavebreaker
skills.description: Kalea slams her fist into the ground, creating a wave that deals 200 (+5% Max HP) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and slows them by 40% for 1.5s.

skills.name: Tidal Strike
skills.description:
Kalea charges forward and body slams the first enemy hero she encounters, knocking them airborne for 0.6s (unaffected by Resilience) while dealing 150 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.
If she collides with an obstacle or touches the edge of a Water Zone during her charge, Kalea will leap into the air. Cast the skill again to slam down at a target location, dealing 150 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and knocking enemies airborne for 0.6s (unaffected by Resilience).

skills.name: Tsunami Slam
skills.description: Kalea grabs an enemy hero with her tail and slams them down in the Joystick's direction (drag the Joystick to change landing spot). She gains Control Immunity during this process. Upon landing, deals 300 (+8% Max HP) Physical Damage to the target and nearby enemies.

assist.desc: Kalea's strong single-target CC makes her work well with heroes who have high single-target burst, like Eudora, Harley, and Clint.

strong.desc: Kalea counters heroes who lack mobility like Layla and Chang'e.

weak.desc: However, Kalea cannot grab enemies with Control Immunity, so heroes like Diggie and Minotaur can effectively counter her.
